  (f₁ : α₁ → β₁ → Finset γ₁) 
  (f₂ : α₂ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) 
  (g₁ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₁) 
  (g₂ : α₁ → β₂ → Finset γ₂) : 
  α₁ ⊕ α₂ → β₁ ⊕ β₂ → Finset (γ₁ ⊕ γ₂) := 
  fun a b => 
    match a with
    | Sum.inl x => 
      match b with
      | Sum.inl y => (f₁ x y).image (fun c => Sum.inl c)
      | Sum.inr y => Finset.biUnion (g₁ x y) (fun c => Finset.single (Sum.inl c))
    | Sum.inr x => 
      match b with
      | Sum.inl y => Finset.biUnion (g₂ x y) (fun c => Finset.single (Sum.inr c))
